notes: Rule: the class of language elements for which different functionality is implemented and standard support is not claimed (cite.py --check 4.2.10 OK). Members in this implementation = the ACCEPT-INERT declined elements (docs/CONFORMANCE.md sections 2/4/5): the VALIDATE statement (COBOL1580), RECORD DELIMITER (COBOL1778) and the OPTIONS FLOAT-DECIMAL clause (COBOL2424, OptionsBinder.DeclineFloatDecimal; A.3 item 13). Asynchronous messaging (SEND/RECEIVE and the EC-MCS-* names) left the class with kb/Work PB4744, which provides it; COMMIT and ROLLBACK left with kb/Work PB3338. Every member is documented in CONFORMANCE.md and flagged at compile time by a NAMED diagnostic through the one seam EditionContext.Declined.
